edu-resource-downloader 1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release: provides a semi-automated, compliant solution for downloading resources from Chinese national free education platforms.
- Supports two key platforms: 国家中小学智慧教育平台 (basic.smartedu.cn) and 学堂在线 (xuetangx.com).
- Guides users to use existing open-source tools rather than generating crawler code.
- Includes prompt templates for AI-assisted configuration, error resolution, and script writing.
- Supplies step-by-step environment setup, recommended tool list, usage flow, and compliance guidelines.
- Emphasizes personal, educational use only—no redistribution or commercial usage allowed.
